ai_summary: Executive Summary: ABM Knowledgeware Limited reported robust year-on-year revenue from operations growth of ~21% for Q2 FY27, reaching 2,670.15 lakhs. However, the company experienced a significant decline in profitability, with Profit Before Tax plummeting ~70% sequentially and ~25% year-on-year, primarily driven by a substantial ~82% sequential surge in operating expenses and lower other income. This material erosion of margins, alongside a year-on-year decrease in half-year profitability, raises a red flag regarding cost management effectiveness despite revenue expansion.
